title: Flow Cytometric Analysis of CD4+ T Cell Reactivation Following Anti-PD1 Immunotherapy
author: Sheriff, Bending

steps.title: Prepare mice and reagents
steps.instruction: Generate F1 Nr4a3‑Tocky Tg4 Tiger mice; titrate in‑vivo grade blocking anti‑PD1 antibodies, peptide, and all flow‑cytometry panel antibodies in advance. Ensure animal work is approved under UK Home Office licences P18A892E0A and PP3965017 (held by D.B.).

steps.title: Primary peptide immunization
steps.instruction: Immunize Tg4 Nr4a3‑Tocky Il10‑GFP mice subcutaneously with 80 µg of [4Y] MBP peptide.

steps.title: Secondary challenge and anti‑PD1 treatment
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after primary immunization, randomise mice to receive either PBS or 8 µg of [4Y] MBP peptide subcutaneously. Thirty minutes before the secondary peptide injection, inject 0.5 mg anti‑PD1 antibody (or 0.5 mg isotype control) intraperitoneally.

steps.title: Harvest splenocytes for analysis
steps.instruction: Four hours after the secondary peptide rechallenge, euthanise mice, harvest spleens, and prepare a single‑cell suspension of splenocytes for flow‑cytometric analysis.

steps.title: Quality‑control PD1 blockade staining
steps.instruction: Stain an aliquot of the harvested splenocytes with a fluorochrome‑conjugated anti‑PD1 antibody (same clone as the in‑vivo blocking antibody) to confirm successful PD1 blockade; exclude mice showing significant residual PD1 staining.

steps.title: 96‑well plate antibody staining
steps.instruction: Perform flow‑cytometric staining of splenocytes in a 96‑well plate as described below (total staining time ≈1 h).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well plate at 500 g for 3 min at 15 °C–25 °C.

Prepare an antibody master mix in 2 % FBS PBS containing a fixable viability dye (eFluor780) diluted 1:2000. Add each antibody at a 1:200 dilution (5 µL per 1 mL master mix): PD1‑PE‑Cy7, OX40‑APC, ICOS‑AF700, CD4‑BUV737, and TCR Vβ8.1/8.2‑BUV395. (Optional: include Fc‑receptor block at this stage.)
Add 25 µL of the master mix to each well containing cells.
Incubate the plate on ice (4 °C) for 20 min.
Add 180 µL ice‑cold 2 % FBS PBS to each well, then centrifuge again at 500 g for 3 min at 15 °C–25 °C.
Decant supernatant, resuspend each pellet in 150 µL 2 % FBS PBS, and transfer to 5 mL FACS tubes.
If desired, rinse the original wells with an additional 150 µL 2 % FBS PBS and combine with the first suspension to obtain a total volume of ~300 µL per sample for acquisition.

Keep cells on ice in the dark and acquire data on a flow cytometer within 2–4 h. Do NOT fix the cells, as fixation abolishes Nr4a3‑Timer Blue fluorescence; acquire promptly because the Timer protein matures slowly from Blue to Red.
